critical_code_review_comments: MINOR: refinement_routes.candidate_decision returns 'Agreement not approved yet' for each of the three agreements when the underlying material has no versions OR has status != Approved. Correct per spec, but the branch reads `agreement.get('material', {}).get('status')` — since get_current_material returns {'material': doc, 'current': version_dict}, the material status IS on the outer material doc, which is what's checked. Verified working in tests. Consider extracting a small helper to reduce cognitive load.

MINOR: WorkspaceModules.StrategyReadySummary parses `versions.slice().reverse().find(v => v.structured)` — but generated_materials.versions edited by PUT /materials/{id} intentionally sets structured:null, so this correctly picks the last AI-generated version. Solid logic.

MINOR: /api/public/sign/{token} SignPayload.email uses `Field(min_length=3)` (plain str) instead of EmailStr — a signer can submit 'a@b' and be accepted. Consider EmailStr for consistency with member routes. Low priority since human-facing form.

MINOR: signature_requests.document_snapshot immutability is enforced only by NOT copying material edits back — nothing prevents an admin/superuser from manually re-writing the snapshot via a direct Mongo write. Acceptable for MVP; consider adding an audit trail if regulatory need arises.

MINOR: Results page uses `applications.filter(a => joined.includes(a))` which relies on reference equality across filter callbacks — works because same array reference, but subtle. A status-based check would be clearer.
NOTE (carried over from iteration 14): DELETE endpoint for workspace/applications still not implemented; the leftover 'owner-review-admin' Draft opportunity still exists in Mongo.
